从豆仓开始，为自己做一杯咖啡。: Start at the bean hopper and make yourself a coffee.
点豆仓加入咖啡豆: Click the hopper to add beans
豆子正在落入豆仓: Beans are falling into the hopper
等研磨完成后锁入手柄: Wait for grinding, then lock in the portafilter
点击手柄锁入冲煮头: Click the portafilter to lock it into the group head
手柄正在对准并旋紧: The portafilter is aligning and locking
把杯子放到出液口下: Place the cup under the spouts
杯子正在移入出液口: The cup is moving under the spouts
观察已定格，可继续观察或结束萃取: Observation frozen. Continue viewing or stop extraction.
等待萃取完成，或再按萃取键停止: Wait for extraction or press Extract again to stop
杯中还没有咖啡，按萃取键重新开始: The cup has no coffee yet. Press Extract to restart.
点击杯子领取拿铁: Click the cup to collect your latte
可加奶泡，或点击杯子领取: Add milk foam or click the cup to collect
点击重新准备，再做一杯: Prepare again to make another cup
本杯目标已锁定，重新准备后可调整。: The current target is locked. Prepare again to change it.
开始萃取后，可以暂停观察水流和液面。: After extraction starts, pause observation to inspect flow and level.
咖啡豆落进豆仓，装好一杯的份量。: Beans fall into the hopper, filling one serving.
研磨中，咖啡粉正在落入粉碗……: Grinding. Grounds are falling into the basket…
研磨完成，点击手柄锁入冲煮头。: Grinding complete. Click the portafilter to lock it into the group head.
抬起粉碗，对准冲煮头，再旋转锁紧。: Lift the basket, align it with the group head and twist to lock.
手柄已锁紧，再把杯子放到出液口下。: Portafilter locked. Place the cup under the spouts next.
端起杯子，放到双出液口正下方。: Lift the cup and place it beneath the twin spouts.
已停止萃取，保留杯中的咖啡。可加奶泡或领取。: Extraction stopped; coffee in the cup is kept. Add foam or collect it.
已停止萃取，杯中还没有咖啡。按萃取键重新开始。: Extraction stopped before coffee reached the cup. Press Extract to restart.
水泵启动，先润湿咖啡粉，再缓缓萃取。: Pump started. The grounds are wetted first, then extraction begins.
正在萃取，咖啡液与油脂慢慢上升。再次按萃取键可停止。: Extracting. Coffee and crema rise slowly. Press Extract again to stop.
咖啡完成。可加入奶泡，或直接领取。: Coffee ready. Add milk foam or collect it directly.
奶泡已经加入，点击杯子领取: Foam already added. Click the cup to collect.
先完成咖啡萃取，再加入奶泡: Finish extracting coffee before adding foam
奶缸抬起，奶泡缓缓注入。: The pitcher lifts and pours foam slowly.
奶缸正在移到杯口……: The pitcher is moving over the cup…
奶泡已注入，奶缸正在归位。: Foam poured. The pitcher is returning.
奶泡缓缓注入，咖啡正在变得柔和。: Foam pours slowly, softening the coffee.
拿铁完成，点击杯子领取。: Latte ready. Click the cup to collect it.
！点击重新准备，再做一杯。: ! Prepare again to make another cup.
锁住粉碗与水路: Lock the basket into the water path
让杯子接住出液: Position the cup to catch the coffee
再看咖啡入杯: Then watch coffee enter the cup
豆仓是研磨的原料入口。加入的豆量会增加，研磨还没有开始。: The hopper supplies beans for grinding. Adding beans increases its contents; grinding has not started.
磨成细粉后，与水接触的面积增大。看豆仓减少、粉碗增加：它们来自同一份豆子。: Grinding increases the surface area exposed to water. The hopper empties as the basket fills with grounds from the same beans.
粉碗先对准冲煮头，再旋紧。锁住后才形成示意水路；未锁紧时不能萃取。: Align the basket with the group head, then twist it tight. Locking completes the illustrated water path; extraction is blocked until then.
杯子要先放稳在出液口下。本模型用杯位检查拦住空放萃取，不是所有实机都有此功能。: Place the cup securely under the spouts first. This model checks cup position to prevent extraction without a cup; not every real machine has that feature.
粉层示意润湿阶段已结束，压力针已抬起；杯中尚未新增咖啡。这里是观察定格，不是实机: The illustrated wetting stage has ended and the pressure needle has risen; no new coffee has reached the cup. This freezes observation, not a real pump.
提前结束时杯中仍不足以领取，可以重新开始润湿。已有少量咖啡不会被清空。: Stopping early may leave too little coffee to collect. Restart wetting; any coffee already present is kept.
先润湿粉层，再进入出液。分步观察会在润湿完成时定格，让你对照压力针与杯中液面。: Wet the grounds before dispensing. Step-by-step observation freezes after wetting so you can compare the needle and cup level.
水穿过粉层，带出可溶物。按同一示意流速入杯，目标杯量越大，出液越久。: Water passes through the grounds and carries soluble material into the cup. At the same illustrated flow rate, a larger target takes longer.
杯子正在移出出液口。端走动作完成后才计入杯数，不能重复领取。: The cup is moving away from the spouts. It counts only after being fully removed; repeated collection is prevented.
奶泡是可选的独立动作，不再启动萃取。完成后再端杯。: Foam is an optional, separate action. It does not restart extraction. Take the cup afterward.
出液已结束，示意压力归零。端杯完成才计入杯数；也可以先自由加奶泡。: Flow has ended and illustrated pressure is zero. The cup counts only after removal; you may add foam first.
继续 · 看咖啡入杯: Continue · watch coffee enter the cup
从豆子到咖啡，动作已经完成。退出保留已完成杯数；重新准备才开始新的一杯。: The bean-to-coffee sequence is complete. Leaving keeps the completed-cup count; prepare again to start another cup.
点击豆仓加入咖啡豆: Click the hopper to add beans
这是流程与压力的简化示意，不是实机参数。打开后可沿着豆仓、粉碗与杯子看动作。: This simplifies the process and pressure; values are not real-machine settings. Open it to follow the hopper, basket and cup.
先把豆子装进豆仓。研磨会把豆子变成细粉，再送入下方粉碗。: Put beans in the hopper first. Grinding turns them into grounds and feeds them into the basket below.
豆子落进豆仓，豆量随入仓动作增加；研磨尚未启动。: Beans fall into the hopper; its contents increase as they enter. Grinding has not started.
豆子已备好。按研磨键后，豆仓里的豆子减少，粉碗里的咖啡粉增加。: Beans ready. Grinding reduces beans in the hopper and increases grounds in the basket.
研磨把豆子变成细粉，咖啡粉沿出粉口落进粉碗；上下两处的量同步变化。: Grinding feeds fine grounds into the basket through the outlet. Both quantities change together.
咖啡粉已落入粉碗。把手柄锁进冲煮头，才能让水穿过粉层。: Grounds are in the basket. Lock the portafilter into the group head so water can pass through them.
粉碗先抬起对准冲煮头，再旋紧手柄；锁紧完成前不能萃取。: Lift and align the basket before twisting the portafilter tight. Extraction stays blocked until locking finishes.
粉碗已锁紧、杯子已就位。按萃取键，先润湿粉层，再让咖啡液流入杯中。: Portafilter locked and cup positioned. Start extraction to wet the grounds, then dispense coffee.
粉碗已锁紧。杯子还未就位，萃取不会启动。: Portafilter locked, but the cup is missing. Extraction will not start.
杯子移到双出液口下方；放稳后才能启动萃取，避免咖啡流到外面。: The cup moves below the twin spouts. Once stable, extraction can begin without spilling outside it.
水泵先建立示意压力并润湿粉层，此时杯中液量还不增加。: The pump first builds illustrated pressure and wets the grounds; the cup volume has not increased yet.
水穿过粉层并带出可溶物，咖啡流入杯中。压力在收尾时回落；再按萃取键会立即停流。: Water passes through the grounds, carrying soluble material into the cup. Pressure falls at the end. Press Extract again to stop flow immediately.
水泵已停止，压力归零。杯中还不足以领取，可以重新启动萃取。: Pump stopped and pressure zero. There is too little coffee to collect; restart extraction.
水泵已停止，压力归零。奶泡已入杯，点击杯子即可领取。: Pump stopped and pressure zero. Foam is in the cup; click it to collect.
水泵已停止，压力归零，杯中咖啡保留。可加奶泡或直接领取。: Pump stopped and pressure zero. Coffee is kept in the cup. Add foam or collect it.
奶缸先移动到杯口；抵达后才开始注入奶泡。: The pitcher first moves above the cup, then starts pouring foam.
奶泡已经注入，奶缸正回到原位；杯中咖啡不会继续增加。: Foam is poured and the pitcher is returning. Coffee volume no longer increases.
奶缸倾斜，奶泡流进杯中；这一步不启动水泵，也不再萃取咖啡。: The tilted pitcher pours foam into the cup. This neither starts the pump nor extracts more coffee.
杯子从出液口下方移出，端走动作完成后才计入已领取杯数。: The cup moves away from the spouts. It counts as collected only after removal finishes.
这一杯已领取。重新准备会清空本轮豆粉与液量，保留已完成杯数。: This cup is collected. Preparing again clears this serving's beans, grounds and liquids while keeping the completed-cup count.
粉层已润湿，杯中尚未新增咖啡。继续这一步才进入出液；这是观察定格，不是实机停泵。: The grounds are wet, but no new coffee is in the cup. Continue to dispense. This freezes observation, not a real pump.
画面已定格，零件位置、液量与计时保持不变。继续观察将从此刻接上。: View frozen. Part positions, liquid levels and timing are unchanged. Continue to resume from this point.
同一示意流速：杯量越多，出液越久。时间不是实机标定；暂停只定格观察，收起会继续。: Same illustrated flow rate: a larger cup takes longer. Times are not real-machine calibration. Pausing freezes observation; closing resumes it.
看懂一步 · 可选分步观察: Follow one step · optional staged observation
退出分步 · 保留当前杯: Leave staged view · keep the current cup
水箱、泵和加热器未绘制。高亮只指向现有部件；压力与时间均为简化示意，不是实机测量: The tank, pump and heater are not drawn. Highlights point only to existing parts. Pressure and time are simplified illustrations, not real measurements.
点豆仓、手柄与杯子，做一杯自己的咖啡: Click the hopper, portafilter and cup to make your coffee
润湿完成，观察已定格。点继续这一步，看看咖啡如何进入杯中。: Wetting complete; observation frozen. Continue this step to see coffee enter the cup.
已暂停观察：动作与计时已定格，可继续观察。: Observation paused. Action and timing are frozen; continue to resume.
热水穿过压实的咖啡粉，带出香气与油脂。奶泡让咖啡变得柔和。: Hot water passes through compacted grounds, carrying aroma and oils. Milk foam softens the coffee.
